message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: Defendant Xu purchased 150 kg of bulk salt, knew it may be non-conforming, used it to process tea eggs sold to consumers. The salt was found to be non-iodized (iodine 0) and not meeting GB5416-2000 standard. In iodine-deficient area, regulations require use of iodized salt in food. So selling food with non-iodized salt is a violation of food safety law, specifically "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". In training examples, similar case: selling industrial salt as food, they labeled "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Also earlier example: "生产、销售假药" etc. So the charge is "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Also possibly "非法经营"? But list includes "非法经营". However the facts are about selling non-iodized salt in food, which is a food safety violation. The canonical label used earlier for similar case: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". So answer: [罪名]生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>.

Check if any other charge: maybe "非法行医"? No. "非法持有枪支"? No. So single charge.

Thus final answer JSON with reasoning and final answer.
